name: bestlife-holder-send
description: Sends your mail with Cloudflare Email Sending, and with Resend on your own key only when Cloudflare did not send it. Never twice.

RESEND_KEY_NAME.description: The name of your Resend key on your access worker (a KEY_RESEND_API_KEY secret there).

BESTLIFE_CALLER_CN.description: The name Best Life signs its requests as: bestlife-caller. Leave it as it is. Empty: Best Life cannot call this worker.

EMAIL.description: Cloudflare Email Sending (needs Workers Paid and your domain onboarded in Email Service).

ACCESS.description: Your access worker, which opens your Resend key (deploy bestlife-holder-access first).

SENT.description: What was sent, so nothing is sent twice (a KV namespace in your account).
